# Staging test data rules

`S6.4` · Coding rule

Staging data: read-only by default; created data prefixed QA-AUTO-YYYYMMDD- and cleaned up; registration flows on demand. No payment setup (USER SAID 2026-09-15): use the existing staging accounts; payment/credit-spending flows are driven up to the step before the confirm/pay act

Defined in [[brain/context/conventions-shared|Rules for all code]].
